# shipit

A small release helper: version parsing, bumping, and release-note formatting
(a synthetic project written for half-life-bench).

Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`.

constraints.reason: The build stamps binaries from VERSION_INFO while the docs and package metadata read __version__, so a mismatch ships two different version numbers.
constraints.text: In shipit/__init__.py, __version__ and VERSION_INFO must always name the same version.

constraints.reason: The release script copies the Unreleased section into the published release notes, so unlogged changes ship undocumented.
constraints.text: Any task that changes a file in shipit/ must also add a bullet describing the change to the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md.
